experiences.text: Mira Ellison began her first overnight at Riverside Night Wing following Dr. Kai Voss along the east corridor. She checked IV bags under the buzzing fluorescent lights. Kai announced his intention to request day shifts after residency, but the topic never came up again. Elara Quinn brought coffee and commented on the unusual quiet.

A code blue sounded for room 14 during that first shift. Mira and Kai pushed the crash cart in and performed compressions for three minutes until the patient stabilized. Later Elara described the identical code as lasting nearly ten minutes amid greater confusion.

Mira had shifted to primary coverage of the west wing by the second life. She reviewed charts with Dr. Soren Hale at the nurses' station. Riven Moss from the lab claimed that Elara always forgot to sign the medication log. Tamsin Grey sorted incoming papers nearby.

Dr. Kai Voss remained on nights then. He said he preferred the quieter hours, yet no formal request was ever filed. Mira handed a warm blanket to the patient in room 7. The monitors beeped at irregular intervals.

Elara Quinn became night supervisor of the full wing in life 3. She reassigned Mira to the east corridor for the shift. Dr. Soren Hale completed a consult in room 22 around midnight. Tamsin Grey observed that staffing looked thin that evening.
Around 3 a.m. a patient reported nausea. Mira checked the chart twice before giving the prescribed antiemetic. Kai heated soup in the break room. Elara watched from the central desk.

Mira received a promotion to weekend charge nurse in life 4. She coordinated a patient transfer with Soren Hale. Riven Moss reported ongoing lab delays for blood work. Staff recalled the old code blue in conflicting ways.

According to one conversation Kai Voss had transferred to day shifts by life 4. He stopped by briefly to collect files. Elara continued on nights without change. Mira located a missing chart beneath the counter.

In the most recent life Mira served as lead on the east corridor. Dr. Soren Hale acted as the only attending overnight. Tamsin Grey announced she intended to begin nurse training, though no confirmation appeared later. Only routine checks filled the quiet hours.

Riven Moss asserted that Kai had always preferred night work even after the transfer. Mira double-checked one medication order before administering it. The fluorescent lights continued to hum overhead as usual.
